title: Satya Nadella praises Xbox restructuring in podcast interview
description: Microsoft's CEO discussed Xbox's restructuring and plans for growth on the Sources podcast, following recent job cuts.
summary: VGC, Eurogamer and PC Gamer cover the same Sources podcast interview with Satya Nadella. He expressed confidence in Xbox's studios and games, supported the team's restructuring, and discussed finding a sustainable business model. The coverage places those remarks in the context of recent layoffs. This topic concerns the interview remarks, rather than a new round of cuts.
